us: Draft terms set: Iran runs channel first · Blockade lift if holds
effects: Trump: open 'very soon' or Iran hit 'very hard' · No tolls
iran: Claims several vessels struck · US-made drone downed near Bandar Abbas · Unconfirmed
tldr: Tehran claimed it struck several 'violating' vessels and downed a US-made drone near Bandar Abbas — claims Washington did not address. Trump paired the offer of a near-term opening with a threat: the strait opens 'very soon' or Iran gets hit 'very hard', and nobody charges tolls ('Anybody's going to charge, we'll charge').
